faq.question: What is JSONL?
faq.answer: JSONL (JSON Lines), also called NDJSON, is a format where each line is a separate, complete JSON value. This tool collects those lines into a single JSON array.

faq.question: How does JSONL to JSON conversion work?
faq.answer: Each non-empty line is parsed as one JSON value. The parsed values are gathered into an array and pretty-printed. Blank lines are skipped.

faq.question: What if one line is invalid?
faq.answer: The tool reports the line number that failed to parse. Fix that line in the source and convert again. It does not silently skip bad lines.

faq.question: Does it support NDJSON?
faq.answer: Yes. NDJSON and JSONL are the same line-delimited format, so NDJSON input works exactly like JSONL.

faq.question: What if my input is already a JSON array on one line?
faq.answer: That single line is parsed as one value, so the output is an array containing your original array. Put one value per line if you want each record to become a separate element.

faq.question: Is this a free JSONL to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can convert JSON Lines to JSON, copy the result, or download it as a .json file without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert JSONL to JSON Online
article.content:
What Is JSONL?

JSONL (JSON Lines), also called NDJSON, stores data as one JSON value per line. Each line is independent, which makes the format easy to stream and log. An NDJSON to JSON step collects those lines into a single array; you can parse JSONL line by line or all at once. Converting it to a JSON array makes the data easier to use in APIs and scripts that expect a single document.

How to Convert JSONL to JSON

  1. Enter JSON Lines: paste one JSON value per line into the input.
  2. Convert: each non-empty line is parsed as a value.
  3. Collect: the values are gathered into a JSON array and pretty-printed.
  4. Copy or download: use the result as a standard JSON array.

Handling Errors

If a line is not valid JSON, the tool reports the failing line number. Blank lines are skipped automatically. Fix the reported line and convert again.

When to Use It

  • Import logs: turn line-delimited logs into a JSON array for analysis.
  • Data pipelines: many tools emit JSONL; convert it for systems that expect one document.
  • Storage migration: move JSONL exports into a single JSON file.

Privacy

Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Your JSONL is not uploaded and no account is required. Do not paste passwords, tokens, or production credentials into any online tool.

article.title: 如何在线把 JSONL 转为 JSON
article.content:
什么是 JSONL？

JSONL（JSON Lines），也叫 NDJSON，把数据存成每行一个 JSON 值。每一行彼此独立，因此这种格式很容易流式传输和记录日志。ndjson 转 json（即 json lines 转 json）把这些行收集成一个数组；你可以逐行解析 jsonl，也可以一次性解析。把它转成 JSON 数组后，在需要单个文档的 API 和脚本里用起来更方便。

如何把 JSONL 转为 JSON

  1. 输入 JSON Lines：把每行一个 JSON 值粘贴到输入框。
  2. 转换：每一行非空内容会被解析成一个值。
  3. 汇总：这些值被收集进一个 JSON 数组并美化输出。
  4. 复制或下载：把结果当作标准 JSON 数组使用。

错误处理

如果某一行不是合法的 JSON，工具会指出出错的行号。空行会自动跳过。修正报告的那一行后再转换即可。

什么时候用它

  • 导入日志：把按行分隔的日志转成 JSON 数组用于分析。
  • 数据管道：很多工具输出 JSONL；转成单文档以适配其他系统。
  • 存储迁移：把 JSONL 导出文件搬进一个 JSON 文件。

隐私

转换完全在你的浏览器中运行，JSONL 不会被上传，也不需要账号。请勿在任何在线工具里粘贴密码、令牌或生产环境凭据。
